name: SignDrop — Free PDF, Word & Photo Document Signer
description: Sign PDFs, Word docs & photos free. Scan a QR to sign on your phone with your finger. Private, on-device, no uploads.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://*.firebaseio.com https://*.firebaseapp.com https://*.googleapis.com wss://*.firebaseio.com
